title: Commissioner's right of action.
bodyText: All remedies, penalties and proceedings set forth in this article are to be invoked solely and exclusively by the commissioner.
caseNotes: This article does not authorize a private cause of action. 795 F. Supp. 1036 (1992).

bodyHtml:
§431:13-107  Commissioner's right of action.  All remedies, penalties and proceedings set forth in this article are to be invoked solely and exclusively by the commissioner. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2]

 

Case Notes

 

  This article does not authorize a private cause of action.  795 F. Supp. 1036 (1992).
